s: 1 month ago - Budget shoppers: The Apple Watch SE 3 is the most affordable Apple Watch, and unless you're comparing them side by side or know what missing features to look for, it has the feel and performance of the Series 11 for $150 less. Thanks to watchOS 26, it even has the same list of activity, exercise, and sleep tracking features. First-time smartwatch buyers: If you're new to smartwatches, the Apple Watch SE 3 will immediately impress with its excellent performance and wide feature set, and you likely don't need to spend more for the few sensors separating it from the Series 11.
